name: Banh bo
summary: Bánh bó is roasted glutinous rice milled fine, packed with candied ginger, candied winter melon, peanuts, and sesame, and sliced thin. A slice is soft, lightly sweet, and nutty.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls a slice soft, lightly sweet, and nutty.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: roast glutinous rice until cooked, mill it fine, and mix in candied ginger, candied winter melon, roasted peanuts, and sesame. Pack it into a long block and slice it thin.
where: Sold as a gift to carry home.
priceBand: 30,000 VND for a 300 g bag (Vietnam Airlines).
seoDescription: Bánh bó, roasted glutinous rice packed with candied ginger, winter melon, peanuts, and sesame, sliced soft and nutty. 30,000 VND for 300 g.
